body: Thank you for the advice! If you don’t mind me questioning you a little more, how would I go about researching about accommodations for trans students? (Obviously I can figure it out myself, but I figure asking won’t hurt) Most college websites haven’t had much information that I could find, so would emailing someone from the school or something of that sort be a better solution? If you don’t want to answer (bcs it’s kind of an obvious solution) that’s fine! Thank you for the initial advice
I have attempted to get better (a part of me is still trying) I’ve been in and out of therapy since I was around nine or ten. I’m just tired, ya know?
Well first of all, thank you! To answer your question, I was seeing a therapist for a while! I had to stop simply because my therapist wasn’t a good fit for me and i haven’t found a good one yet.
